responsibility: Defines the templated ForeverStack data structure that underpins Resolver2_0 lexical name lookup across namespaces. This file models each namespace as a persistent tree of Rib nodes linked by scope-creation edges carrying NodeIds and optional named-path segments, supports push/pop without discarding old scopes so later passes can revisit the same scope graph, and exposes the core APIs for inserting definitions, resolving identifiers and multi-segment paths, reconstructing canonical paths, locating ribs by scope id, and debugging the namespace stack state.
